name: Love Nocturna
source:
You stumble into a town, enshrouded and plagued, and straight into a beast's clutches. Can you earn your escape?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你误入一座笼罩在阴霾里、灾厄缠身的小镇，一头撞进了野兽的利爪。你能为自己挣得一条逃生之路吗？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
